str_intro_1: The old house greeted us with silence. Only the wind roams through the cracks.
str_intro_2: Someone is here. I can feel it.
str_intro_3: Did you hear that? Down there...
str_cellar_1: The steps creak. The lantern light drowns in damp darkness.
str_cellar_2: A shadow stirs in the corner. Your heart is pounding in your throat.
str_cellar_3: The shadow in the corner is just an old coat on a hook.
str_hall_1: Fine... But I'll come back. Alone, if I have to.
str_hall_2: The door slammed shut. A quiet whisper rose from below.
